column1: # AMR gene ground truth for scripts/evaluate_run.py (tab-separated, one file per run).
# Complete truth for run expr2_05B_0.100A_4H_3G.
# read_id : read name exactly as it appears in the run's FASTA/FASTQ (first word of the header)
# gene    : AMR gene carried by the read. A read with two genes gets two rows.
# aliases : optional, "|"-separated names that also count as this gene in any database.
#           Names are compared after normalization (lowercase, no "(Class)" prefix,
#           no "_N" allele suffix, no punctuation), so dfrA5_4 and (Tmt)dfrA5 already
#           match dfrA5. Aliases are merged across all rows of the same gene, so they
#           only need to be written once. A family name (e.g. megares "DFRA") lets
#           that database match, but then every gene of the family counts as this one;
#           add it only when no other gene of that family is in the sample.
# Reads not listed carry no gene: any hit on them counts as a false positive.
# List every gene really present (including chromosomal ones), or precision will be low.
# Lines starting with "#" are ignored.
